sections.title: Surveys
sections.description: Overviews focused on pretrained models for tabular prediction.

papers.title: The Current Generation of Tabular Foundation Models: A Critical Review
papers.summary: Reviews model families, pretraining regimes, deployment choices, and limitations of the current TFM literature.

sections.title: Foundations and Prior-Data Fitted Networks
sections.description: The ideas behind learning a predictor across tasks before applying it to a new table.

papers.title: Transformers Can Do Bayesian Inference
papers.summary: Introduces prior-data fitted networks that learn to approximate posterior prediction from datasets sampled from a prior.

papers.title: TabPFN: A Transformer That Solves Small Tabular Classification Problems in a Second
papers.summary: Uses synthetic prior training to predict small classification datasets from labeled context without target-specific weight updates.

papers.title: Accurate predictions on small data with a tabular foundation model
papers.summary: Extends the TabPFN approach to classification and regression using a pretrained predictor conditioned on the target dataset.

sections.title: Synthetic-Prior Pretraining and Scalable In-Context Learning
sections.description: Models trained on generated tasks, with work on prior diversity, architecture, and inference efficiency.

papers.title: TabICL: A Tabular Foundation Model for In-Context Learning on Large Data
papers.summary: Combines column and row representations with efficient in-context learning for tabular classification.

papers.title: Mitra: Mixed Synthetic Priors for Enhancing Tabular Foundation Models
papers.summary: Studies a curated mixture of synthetic task generators for pretrained classification and regression.

papers.title: TabPFN-2.5: Advancing the State of the Art in Tabular Foundation Models
papers.summary: Reports a new TabPFN generation with expanded synthetic priors, larger supported tasks, and adaptation options.

papers.title: TabICLv2: A better, faster, scalable, and open tabular foundation model
papers.summary: Expands TabICL with classification and regression, revised synthetic task generation, and more efficient training and inference.

papers.title: TabPFN-3: Technical Report
papers.summary: Describes changes to TabPFN pretraining and inference, alongside extensions to additional data settings.

papers.title: Mitra-v2 Technical Report
papers.summary: Expands synthetic pretraining diversity and context capacity for classification and regression.

papers.title: TabPFN-3.5: Technical Report
papers.summary: Reports the next TabPFN release and evaluates its behavior across standard and more varied tabular tasks.

papers.title: TabFM: A Zero-Shot Foundation Model for Tabular Data
papers.summary: Uses synthetic task pretraining for tabular in-context prediction and studies calibration and ensembling.

sections.title: Real-Data and Cross-Table Pretraining
sections.description: Transfer across heterogeneous tables, including real-data pretraining and knowledge-graph-based representations.

papers.title: TransTab: Learning Transferable Tabular Transformers Across Tables
papers.summary: Builds transferable representations across tables with changing or partially overlapping feature schemas.

papers.title: XTab: Cross-table Pretraining for Tabular Transformers
papers.summary: Pretrains shared transformer components across heterogeneous datasets using table-specific input and output components.

papers.title: UniTabE: A Universal Pretraining Protocol for Tabular Foundation Model in Data Science
papers.summary: Uses a unified table representation and pretraining protocol to support transfer across schemas and downstream tasks.

papers.title: Towards Cross-Table Masked Pretraining for Web Data Mining
papers.summary: Introduces CM2, combining semantic column representations with masked pretraining across web tables.

papers.title: CARTE: Pretraining and Transfer for Tabular Learning
papers.summary: Represents rows as graphs and transfers knowledge-graph-pretrained representations to heterogeneous tabular tasks.

papers.title: TabDPT: Scaling Tabular Foundation Models on Real Data
papers.summary: Pretrains on real tables and uses retrieved examples as context for prediction on a new dataset.

papers.title: TabDPT-Turbo: Efficient In-Context Learning for Tabular Prediction
papers.summary: Studies row-based attention and longer-context real-data pretraining to improve in-context prediction efficiency.

sections.title: Semantic and Language-Model-Based Prediction
sections.description: Models that use feature names, text values, or language pretraining. General LLM approaches are marked as adjacent work.

papers.title: TabLLM: Few-shot Classification of Tabular Data with Large Language Models
papers.summary: An adjacent LLM approach that serializes table rows into text for few-shot classification.

papers.title: Large Scale Transfer Learning for Tabular Data via Language Modeling
papers.summary: Introduces TabuLa-8B and transfers language-model pretraining to tabular prediction through a large collection of table tasks.

papers.title: TabSTAR: A Tabular Foundation Model for Tabular Data with Text Fields
papers.summary: Learns target-aware semantic representations for text-containing tables through cross-dataset pretraining and downstream adaptation.

papers.title: ConTextTab: A Semantics-Aware Tabular In-Context Learner
papers.summary: Combines real-table pretraining and semantic representations to condition tabular predictions on labeled examples.

sections.title: Alternative and Unified Architectures
sections.description: Complementary mechanisms, including generated classifier weights, conditional distribution modeling, and attention design.

papers.title: HyperFast: Instant Classification for Tabular Data
papers.summary: Meta-trains a hypernetwork that generates a task-specific classifier, providing an alternative to direct in-context prediction.

papers.title: LimiX: Unleashing Structured-Data Modeling Capability for Generalist Intelligence
papers.summary: Models variables and missingness jointly to answer different conditional prediction queries with a shared structured-data model.

papers.title: Orion-MSP: Multi-Scale Sparse Attention for Tabular In-Context Learning
papers.summary: Combines multi-scale sparse attention with memory compression for tabular context processing.

papers.title: Orion-Bix: Bi-Axial Attention for Tabular In-Context Learning
papers.summary: Uses attention across rows and features to integrate local and global information for tabular in-context prediction.

papers.title: LimiX-2M: Mitigating Low-Rank Collapse and Attention Bottlenecks in Tabular Foundation Models
papers.summary: Revises feature tokenization and attention order to improve representation capacity and computational efficiency.

sections.title: Adaptation, Context Selection, and Pipelines
sections.description: How pretrained predictors are adapted, supplied with context, and integrated into larger workflows.

papers.title: Fine-tuned In-Context Learning Transformers are Excellent Tabular Data Classifiers
papers.summary: Introduces TabForestPFN and studies forest-based synthetic priors together with target-dataset fine-tuning.

papers.title: Exploring Fine-Tuning for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.summary: Compares adaptation strategies and investigates when fine-tuning helps or harms tabular foundation models.

papers.title: Active In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.summary: Studies active acquisition of labeled examples to construct more useful in-context learning sets.

papers.title: TabFM-Auto: Self-Evolving Pipelines for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.summary: Uses an LLM agent and validation feedback to revise data preparation, feature engineering, context selection, and postprocessing around TabFM.

sections.title: Benchmarks and Evaluation
sections.description: Resources for comparing accuracy, budgets, generalization, and predictive reliability.

papers.title: When Do Neural Nets Outperform Boosted Trees on Tabular Data?
papers.summary: Introduces TabZilla and analyzes dataset-dependent differences between neural networks and boosted trees.

papers.title: TabRepo: A Large Scale Repository of Tabular Model Evaluations and its AutoML Applications
papers.summary: Provides cached predictions and evaluations for analyzing model selection, tuning, and ensembles.

papers.title: TabReD: Analyzing Pitfalls and Filling the Gaps in Tabular Deep Learning Benchmarks
papers.summary: Examines gaps in existing benchmarks, including time-dependent data and the role of feature engineering.

papers.title: TabArena: A Living Benchmark for Machine Learning on Tabular Data
papers.summary: Provides a maintained benchmarking system with explicit model configurations, tuning, and ensembling comparisons.

papers.title: The Illusion of Generalization in Tabular Language Models
papers.summary: Re-evaluates TabuLa-8B and investigates task construction, baseline strength, and contamination in tabular language-model evaluation.

papers.title: Beyond IID: How General Are Tabular Foundation Models, Really?
papers.summary: Introduces BeyondArena to compare performance across tabular regimes extending beyond conventional IID benchmarks.

papers.title: Empirical Evaluation of Out-Of-Distribution Performance of Tabular Foundation Models
papers.summary: Evaluates selected TFMs under label, social, and geographic distribution shifts.

papers.title: TabReliBench: Evaluating Tabular Foundation Models Beyond Predictive Accuracy
papers.summary: Examines distributional predictions, calibration, subgroup coverage, and interval efficiency alongside point accuracy.

sections.title: Pretraining Corpora
sections.description: Data resources relevant to transfer, provenance, and contamination analysis.

papers.title: TabLib: A Dataset of 627M Tables with Context
papers.summary: Collects tables and surrounding context from web and code sources for large-scale table research.
